easy_vic_build.tools.params_func

Parameter-generation and transformation modules.

This subpackage provides parsers, dataset builders, scaling operators, transfer functions, and parameter presets for VIC-related workflows.

Modules

GlobalParamParser

Parser utilities for VIC global parameter files.

Scaling_operator

Statistical scaling operators used by parameter aggregation workflows.

TransferFunction

Transfer functions and soil-layer resampling utilities for VIC parameters.

build_Param_interface

Interfaces for building VIC parameter datasets.

createParametersDataset

Create NetCDF templates for VIC parameters and routing flow direction.

params_set

Module easy_vic_build.tools.params_func.params_set.

veg_type_attributes_umd_prepare

Prepare UMD vegetation-attribute JSON with monthly roughness/displacement.
